testPlan.title: junction numbers, ground heights, farm tracks, spacing, pattern builds, two trucks

test.title: The game loaded this build
test.hint: Ticks itself: the running build is the one this plan was packed with.

test.title: Junction numbers show over the junctions
test.hint: Open the junction tool: yellow numbers over wired junctions, blue over cleared ones, split parts by name (j39se). The card row junction numbers turns them off, and they stay off after a restart.

test.title: Placed and built points sit on the ground
test.hint: Clear 28 and place it; clear 7 and build it. Pick the new turns with Ground: nothing to fix, and no point floats or sinks.

test.title: A plain T or X builds as the mod's pattern
test.hint: Clear a plain two-lane T or X (through roads kept), then build: the log says it is laid as the pattern (ticks itself), and it looks like the placed one.

test.title: Built turns have their points well apart
test.hint: Build a junction the pattern does not fit (a Y, a skewed one): the turn points sit about 3-5 m apart on wide turns, closer on tight ones, and trucks still drive them at a steady speed.

test.title: Farm-track junction 101 builds drivable
test.failLog: turn%(s%) we laid cannot be driven
test.hint: Clear 101 (through roads kept), build with a 3-6 m turn radius: short turns at the middle, no loop across the field, and the route check is clean both ways along the track.

test.title: Builds come out drivable
test.passLog: AutoDrive can take through here, all of them turns we meant
test.failLog: turn%(s%) we laid cannot be driven
test.hint: Build a few junctions. Ticks itself: pass on a clean route check, fail if any build says a turn cannot be driven.

test.title: Two trucks share a junction without trouble
test.hint: On a junction you just built or placed, send two AutoDrive trucks through at the same time on crossing or merging routes: one waits, the other goes, no crash, nobody stuck. Try it a few times with different timing.

test.title: A save keeps the split
test.hint: Change a split decision, save the game, reload: the decision is still there.
